name: HFGaussian
definition: A human-centric Gaussian framework that estimates 3D human avatars with integrated biomechanical features (3D skeleton, 3D keypoints, dense pose) and 3D pose in real time from sparse input images, without fine-tuning on unseen data.
summary: HFGaussian is a feed-forward framework using Gaussian splatting to reconstruct 3D human avatars and biomechanical features from sparse images without parametric models.
